# War Scroll Column 12 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 12 | **Condition:** complete

---

**12:1** Praise the God of Israel, who keeps His faithful love toward His covenant people and opens the way of salvation for those He has rescued! He called the weak and stumbling

**12:2** to accomplish astonishing feats of power, and He gathered the nations together only to annihilate them completely. He raised up

**12:3** the discouraged to stand tall in judgment, and He gave the speechless a voice to sing for joy. He trained untrained hands for battle,

**12:4** and He strengthened shaking knees to stand firm. Through the humble in spirit, the hard-hearted will be

**12:5** brought to judgment, and through those who walk blamelessly, every wicked nation will meet its end. Not one of their warriors will remain standing,

**12:6** because the God of Israel and the angel of His truth fight for all who belong to the light. You created Belial

**12:7** for the abyss, a hostile angel whose realm is darkness, whose every plan breeds wickedness and guilt. Every spirit

**12:8** under his command is bent on destruction; they follow the rules of darkness, and that is where all their longing leads. But we

**12:9** belong to Your truth, and we celebrate Your mighty power. Your deliverance fills us with gladness, and we shout for joy

**12:10** at Your strength and Your peace. Who in all creation has strength like Yours, O God of Israel? Your mighty hand reaches out to

**12:11** the lowly. What angel or ruler can offer help like Your very presence? For You

**12:12** set the day of battle in motion long ago [...] to champion truth and abolish guilt, to overthrow darkness

**12:13** and lift up the light, to establish [...] an everlasting foundation, and to wipe out all who belong to darkness, bringing joy

**12:14** to all who belong to the light. Just as the fire of His fury consumed the idols of Egypt,

**12:15** so will You act against [...] For You are the God of our ancestors; we praise Your name forever.

**12:16** We are the people You chose as Your own; You made a covenant with our ancestors, and You will keep it for their children

**12:17** through every age to come. In all the glorious seasons You appointed, You have remembered Your faithful love toward us, helping the remnant, the survivors of Your covenant, so that we may tell of Your true acts and the verdicts of Your astonishing power.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 12 celebrates God's reversal of weakness into strength. "Covenant-faithfulness" rendered as "faithful love" to convey the warmth of hesed. "Poor in spirit" (12:4) rendered "humble in spirit" for clarity. The Light/Darkness dualism is rendered with "belong to" language for accessibility. The allusion to the exodus (12:14) connects the eschatological battle to Israel's founding deliverance.*
